name: Flat-To-Form Metal Specialties, Inc.
old_description: We serve many different manufacturers in Michigan and Beyond. Read what some of our clients have to say about our custom fabrication services.
about:
Flat-To-Form Metal Specialties, Inc. was founded in 1995 in Fremont, Michigan, where it operates a sheet metal fabrication shop serving manufacturers across the region and beyond. The company is privately held; no specific ownership designation such as veteran- or woman-owned is publicly stated.

The shop provides a full range of custom fabrication services, including turret punching (24 gauge to 7 gauge), shearing, forming, MIG/TIG/spot/stud welding, laser cutting, plasma cutting, tapping, press‑in fastener installation, assembly of hinges, gaskets and hardware, and custom prototyping. Materials processed include stainless steel, aluminum, cold‑rolled steel, galvanized, galvannealed, hot‑rolled pickled & oiled, and fish paper. The company handles orders from single prototypes to runs of thousands of assembled pieces, though no fixed facility size or headcount is disclosed.

Customers span general manufacturing, lubrication‑system builders (Mighty Lube Systematic Lubrication in Fremont and OPCO Lubrication Systems in West Michigan), office‑furniture makers, and gas‑pump manufacturers. The firm emphasizes delivery flexibility, offering local pickup, UPS, FedEx, and freight trucking from its Fremont location.

Flat‑To‑Form highlights its ISO 9001:2015‑certified quality system, backed by internal audits, management reviews, and annual surveillance audits, as a core differentiator. It also promotes a one‑stop‑shop model that combines punching, forming, welding, laser, plasma, assembly and finishing under one roof, plus rapid prototyping for design validation.
